Cafe Hero Sunday Ride

Columbus, OH · Italian Village · Road

No-drop

Cafe Hero Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Columbus, OH. Schedule: Every Sunday morning, April–October; 2nd Sunday of the month is the no-drop pace-group ride, from Hoof Hearted Brewing (5th Ave). Pace: a/B/C pace groups on 2nd Sundays; looser 'decaffeinated' rides other weeks.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a/B/C pace groups on 2nd Sundays; looser 'decaffeinated' rides other weeks. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @cafeheroride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cafe Hero Sunday Ride group ride

Coffee and a group ride out of Hoof Hearted in Italian Village, with discounted Royal Flamingo coffee before and after. Second Sunday each month has A, B and C groups and is no-drop for everyone. Times and routes are posted on the Strava club.
